About the_baRRista

We're your neighbours. We make your coffee.

We are the_baRRista. Why the double 'r'? One for the future baRrister, one for the current baRista.

Built in Puncak Perdana, it is a student-led coffee setup designed exclusively for those who refuse to slow down. We stripped away the corporate gimmicks and overcomplicated menus to focus on what matters: late night fuel.

Whether you're pulling a 2 AM all-nighter or locking into an early morning sprint, we serve espresso, matcha, and guilt-free zero-sugar options syrup. No compromises—just clean, crash-free energy delivered straight to your block or ready at our stall in minutes.
